All statements are logically connected, with clear cause-effect relationships (e.g., factory shutdowns causing negative EBITDA, operational costs leading to real estate revenue decline). The narrative flows sequentially from performance deterioration to specific financial metrics, balance sheet changes, and strategic actions. No self-contradictions exist, and the organization groups related information effectively (revenue, profitability, balance sheet, actions).
